error.title: Something went wrong.
error.description: An unexpected error interrupted this page. Try again, or return to the homepage to continue from a safe route.

databaseSchema.title: Database update required
databaseSchema.description: The application and database schema do not match. A required table or field is missing.
databaseSchema.nextStep: An administrator should apply pending database migrations from the project directory, then try again.

databaseBusy.title: Database connection limit reached
databaseBusy.description: The database cannot accept another connection right now.
databaseBusy.nextStep: Try again shortly. If this continues, an administrator should check the application's database connection pool.

databaseUnavailable.title: Database unavailable
databaseUnavailable.description: RentnerProxy cannot connect to the configured database.
databaseUnavailable.nextStep: An administrator should check that PostgreSQL is running and that the database connection settings are correct.

databaseAuthentication.title: Database access rejected
databaseAuthentication.description: The database rejected the application's configured access credentials.
databaseAuthentication.nextStep: An administrator should check the configured database account, password, and access permissions.

sessionExpired.title: Sign-in required
sessionExpired.description: Your session is no longer valid, or this page requires a new sign-in.
sessionExpired.nextStep: Return to the homepage, sign in again, and reopen this page.

accessDenied.title: Access denied
accessDenied.description: Your account does not have permission to access this page or its data.
accessDenied.nextStep: Return to the homepage. If you need access, ask an administrator to check your account's permissions.

notFound.title: Requested data not found
notFound.description: The requested data no longer exists or is no longer available.
notFound.nextStep: Return to the homepage and reopen the item from the current list.

rateLimited.title: Too many requests
rateLimited.description: The request limit has been reached temporarily.
rateLimited.nextStep: Wait a moment before trying again. Avoid repeatedly refreshing the page.

serviceUnavailable.title: A required service is unavailable
serviceUnavailable.description: A service needed to load this page is temporarily unavailable.
serviceUnavailable.nextStep: Try again shortly. If this continues, send the error code and reference to an administrator to check the server logs.

network.title: Connection interrupted
network.description: The connection to the application could not be completed.
network.nextStep: Check your network connection and try again. If other pages work, an administrator should check the application server.

assetLoad.title: Application files could not be loaded
assetLoad.description: A required application or language file could not be downloaded.
assetLoad.nextStep: Try again to reload the page. If this continues, check your connection and ask an administrator to check the deployment.

unexpected.title: The page could not be loaded
unexpected.description: An unexpected error occurred. The application could not determine a more specific cause.
unexpected.nextStep: Try again. If this continues, send the error code and any reference to an administrator to check the browser and server logs.

notFound.title: Page not found.
notFound.description: The page you are looking for does not exist or may have moved. The RentnerProxy foundation is still running.
